environment.tool: manual audit of the final tag source + live compiled binary; raw-socket client sending exact bytes, strict-token upstream peer logging verbatim request bytes and byte count

findings.description: Successive identity-AE attacks on the same raw target with cmd=id, cmd=pwd and cmd=uname each fetch upstream once (hit counts 3,5,6) and overwrite the same cache entry; the captured upstream lines show the attacker-chosen command inside the smuggled second request. The next victim to the same target always refetches after an overwrite, then serves the new command output from cache on subsequent hits, so the attacker chooses what the next victims execute without touching them.
findings.title: Attacker-chosen command is embedded in the cached entry and each overwrite retargets later victims

limitations: All RCE in this corpus is RCE on the upstream host
methods: Control request first on the same config
Raw client bytes and raw upstream bytes captured in hex
Payload diffed against the control line

author_attested: analysis metadata reconstructed after the run
